phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, ground-oriented posture with moderate production and light tech, economy moderate, expansion developing.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy shows signs of early attack or fast expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize drones and expansion, maintain minimal defensive Zerglings and Queens, keep scouting for early threats.
phase_policies.target: Expand economy and establish a solid foundation; continue producing Zerglings and Queens for defense.
phase_policies.title: Early Economy Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to army production at the expense of economy; avoid neglecting scouting for early aggression or fast expansion.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, both players ground-oriented with moderate production and light tech, strong economy and expansion.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy pressure becomes apparent or if you scout a tech switch or expansion timing.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance drone and unit production, maintain scouting, keep tech and production steady, prepare to respond to threats.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing ground army and economy; maintain production and tech levels while watching for threats.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro Development
phase_policies.veto: Avoid premature aggression that sacrifices drones or disrupts economy; do not neglect scouting for tech switches or all-ins.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, enemy ground posture with heavy production and moderate tech, your army includes Roaches.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy shows signs of air transition or timing attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add Roaches and upgrades, maintain economy and production, scout for tech switches, adjust if air threat emerges.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army by adding more Roaches and tech upgrades; continue expanding economy and production.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Strengthening
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-invest in Roaches if enemy is teching to air; avoid neglecting expansion and economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, enemy ground posture with heavy production and moderate-to-heavy tech, your army may include air units.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if enemy tech switches to air or if a large engagement is imminent.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain strong economy and production, upgrade units, adapt composition based on scouting, prepare for major engagement.
phase_policies.target: Consolidate ground army and continue upgrades; if air transitioned, increase air presence and maintain economy/production.
phase_policies.title: Ground Consolidation or Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air defense if enemy has air; avoid overcommitting to one composition without scouting.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
